notes.title: What is Fever Mode?
notes.notes:
Enter Fever Mode!

Rumbly’s mechanic – Fever Mode – lets players deal insane damage by keeping up perfect combos and gain MP recover!!

This is where reflex meets rhythm.

⚡ Perfect timing = more power and more fever gain!!
🎯 Stack fever gauge to activate Fever Mode
🔥 Great for speed runners and score hunters

Try it in the free demo and Wishlist the game to be notified at launch!

notes.title: Rumbly Demo is Ready – Get Ready to Dive In!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We’re excited to announce that the **Rumbly demo is now fully prepared and ready to go**! 💥

Rumbly is a fast-paced, turn-based roguelike where **quick reflexes and smart decisions** are the key to victory. The demo will give you a first taste of our signature **combo battle system**, unique blessings, powerful skills, and intense enemy encounters.

🛠️ We've been hard at work polishing the experience, and we can’t wait to share it with you.

🗓️ The demo will be available very soon — just in time for **Steam Next Fest**!

📌 Be sure to **Wishlist and Follow** Rumbly so you don’t miss the moment it goes live.

Thanks for your support, and we’ll see you in battle!  
– The Rumbly Team

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560988/401736815fec510cc9d29e8ed01be4707a31961a.png[/img]

notes.title: 🐤 Rumbly is joining Steam Next Fest this June! 💥
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We’re thrilled to announce that Rumbly will be part of Steam Next Fest this June! 🎉
Get ready to flap, dodge, and combo your way through fast-paced battles in our brand new free demo — available during the event!

🗓️ Mark your calendar:
Steam Next Fest runs from June 10–17, 2025
You’ll be able to download and play the demo throughout the event!

What to expect in the demo:

💨 Fast-paced turn-based combat where timing is everything

🦇 Challenging enemies with unique attack patterns

🎁 Blessing system with powerful synergies

🛍️ Shop upgrades and unlockable characters

🎯 Combo & Fever systems for high-skill gameplay

We’ve poured our feathers into this and can’t wait for you to try it out.
Until then — don’t forget to wishlist the game and spread the word!

❤️
Team Rumbly
